Ben: coffee machine on 3rd floor is broken again, facilities ticket filed.

Chandra: I watched the new onboarding video, it is a bit long.
Priya: parking passes renew end of month, see the wiki.
Dev: the staging cluster was flaky yesterday morning but recovered.
--- launch discussion ---
Ada: we cannot slip past Q3, marketing already booked the announcement.
Ben: engineering says the migration needs one more week of soak.
Chandra: proposal — freeze scope now, ship the beta first.
DECISION: launch is set for 2026-08-11, and Priya owns the go/no-go call.
Dev: I will send the updated timeline to the channel after this.
Priya: thanks, I will schedule the go/no-go review for the 8th.
Ada: also the vending machine takes the new badges now, fyi.
